principle: Per transport route: the full implementation TIER LADDER (stock client -> librbxport shim -> native C broker -> raw medium ceiling) and the MAXIMUM sealed throughput, then the standards-COMPLIANT maximum for EVERY compliance profile. All rates machine-measured (provenance per row); an unoptimized row always carries its optimized answer. Profiles compose the SAME per-message AES-256-GCM seal (CNSA-2.0 symmetric leg) at the same steady-state ceiling but differ in the authenticated PQC/hybrid handshake, internal security level, and COMSEC/TRANSEC guarantee.
